dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́, ezali kɔ́mɔ́sɔ́ domaine ya science oyo ezali na impact mingi kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́.
dialogue.translation: Also, it is a field of science that has a significant impact, however.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́mɔ́, kí mokili ezali kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́mɔ́sɛ́ limite kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́mɔ́kí na yango.

dialogue.translation: And, we need to think about human life however.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sɔ́kɔ, kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́, ezali mbeke mingi kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́mɔ́sɛ́ contrôle.

dialogue.text: Kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́mɔ́, kí bandá mingi bazali kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́mɔ́kɔ́ na yango.
